# Delivery Proposal

**Prepared for**: Northwind Robotics
**Date**: 2026-05-04

## Agenda

1. System Overview
2. Ways of Working
3. Cost

## 1. System Overview

### 1.1. Project Background

Northwind runs three warehouse sites on a scheduling tool built in 2014.

## 2. Ways of Working

### 2.1. One Team, Two Timezones

Engineers sit in Da Nang and Osaka. Standups run at the overlap hour, and every
decision is written down before it is acted on.

### 2.2. Trunk-Based Delivery

Every change lands on main behind a flag. Releases are a config switch, not an event.

### 2.3. Evidence Over Opinion

Each sprint closes with measured numbers. Nothing is reported as done without a
run that proves it.

### 2.4. Handover From Day One

Documentation is written as the code is written. The client's own team can take
the system over at any point.

## 3. Cost

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Development | 120,000 |
| Operations | 18,000 |
